generation.scope: On every finite Frobenius window with at least ten geometric points, a distinct opposite root must yield a nonzero octic vanishing triply on the configuration. This includes arbitrary embedded multiplicities. A local contact annihilator, the planar Newton polygon bound, and projection from a nonplanar site eliminate all singular matrices there. Octic-free finite edges in this range have at most one regular extension on all components.

open_mathematics: Study the residual configurations on at most nine sites using contact annihilators and projections from fat sites, and continue unrestricted regularity and component classification.
